days.label: Push Day ? Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: No log this week ? staying at 135. Push day didn't get logged, which means no data and no movement. 135 is still your working weight and it's not going anywhere until you show up and prove it. Touch the chest, brief pause, drive through the heels, stay braced the whole set. Need 8/8/8 at RPE 7 or under across all three sets to earn 140. Log it this time.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: No log ? staying at 45. Still waiting on 10/10/10 at RPE 7 or under. Last confirmed data was 9/10/10 at RPE 8/8/9. You need all three sets to clean up before we move. 30-degree incline, elbows at 45 degrees off the torso, control the negative. Set 1 is where you keep losing the rep ? dial in your setup before you unrack, not after.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: No log ? staying at 30. Last confirmed was 10/10/10 at RPE 7/8/8. Close, but sets 2 and 3 are still at RPE 8. Press straight up, full lockout, no lean back. Rest the full 90 seconds ? that's how you get set 3 under RPE 8. Need all three sets at RPE 7 to earn 35.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: No log ? staying at 15. Last confirmed was 12/10/10 at RPE 9/8/8. The weight is right but the execution isn't there yet. Slight elbow bend, lead with the elbow, 2-second hold at the top, slow the negative. Stop swinging. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 or under to earn 20.

exercises.name: Tricep Rope Pushdown
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out dumbbell flyes and overhead rope extension this week. Rope pushdown hits the triceps in a different angle than the overhead work and gives you a cleaner baseline to track. Start at 40 lbs. Rope attachment, elbows pinned to your sides, split the rope at the bottom, full extension on every rep. This is not a test of how heavy you can go ? it's a test of how locked in your form is. Aim for 10-12 at RPE 7. Log all three sets with weight and RPE.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? bodyweight dips on the dip bars. Lean slightly forward to bring the chest into the movement. Full range of motion: lower until upper arms are at least parallel to the floor, press to full lockout at the top. No half reps. If bodyweight feels too easy, note your RPE and we'll talk about adding load next week. If it's a grind, that's fine ? this is a first baseline. Aim for 8-10 reps at RPE 7-8. Log all three sets.

days.cooldown: Stretch chest, shoulders, and triceps ? 5 min

days.label: Pull Day ? Back, Biceps & Rear Delts
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + band pull-aparts + cat-cow stretches

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: No log this week ? staying at 195. Pull day wasn't logged either. 195 is still your working weight and it's not moving until you earn it. Last confirmed session was 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 ? solid response to the jump from 185, but the effort cost said stay. Lats tight from the floor, bar dragging up the shins, breathing reset between every rep. Need 8/8/8 at RPE 7 or under, or hit 10/10/10, to earn 205.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
exercises.notes: No log ? staying at 55. This is the third week in a row with some version of drama on this exercise. You were prescribed 55 last week and no log came in. Prescription is 55. Load 55. Pull to the hip, full second squeeze at the top, slow the negative. Strap up if grip is the issue. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 60.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: No log ? staying at 110. Last confirmed was 10/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8. Set 1 was clean, sets 2 and 3 faded. Wide grip, pull to upper chest, hard lat squeeze at the bottom. Stay upright ? don't row it down. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 or under to earn 120.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: No log ? staying at 70. This has been back at 70 since you jumped to 75 without authorization and went 12/12/12 at RPE 9/9/9. The prescription is 70. Rope at upper pulley, pull to your face, thumbs pointing behind you at the finish, elbows high, external rotation at the end of every rep. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 or under to earn 75.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: No log ? staying at 55. This was a rotation-in week and you didn't log it. First baseline at 55 lbs is still pending. Strict form, elbows pinned to your sides, no swinging, full curl to shoulder height, slow controlled negative. Aim for 8-10 at RPE 7. Log all three sets this time ? this is exactly the kind of movement that gets skipped and stalls your arm development.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Flye
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? reverse flye is back. Last confirmed session was strong: 12/12/12 at RPE 7/7/7 at 15 lbs. That's a clean baseline. Bent over at the hips, soft bend in the knees, arms arc out wide, squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top. Don't let momentum do the work. Staying at 15 this week ? need to confirm you can replicate that performance before we move. If you hit 12/12/12 at RPE 7 again, you earn 20.

days.cooldown: Stretch lats, biceps, and upper back ? 5 min

days.label: Leg Day ? Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + bodyweight squats + leg swings

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 165 ? you went 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 again. Second session in a row with the same result: right in range, RPE solid but not under the threshold. You're building on 165 consistently now which is a good sign after the long gap ? but we need reps to climb before weight does. Below parallel, big breath before you unrack, brace hard, drive through the heels. Need 9-10 reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or under to earn 175.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: UP to 155 ? you finally nailed it: 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7. All three sets at the top of the range and all at RPE 7. That's exactly what earning a bump looks like. Jumping to 155. Slight knee bend, hips back, bar tracks close to the legs, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom. Don't round the lower back. The weight jumps but the standard doesn't ? still need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to keep moving.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? you went 10/10/10 at RPE 7/8/8. Set 1 cleaned up to RPE 7 which is progress, but sets 2 and 3 are still at RPE 8 and you're stuck at 10 reps when the target is 12. You have two reps left in the tank ? stop putting the dumbbells down early. Rear foot on the bench, drop straight down, front shin stays vertical, drive through the front heel. Log each side separately. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 or under to earn 35.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Staying at 75 ? you went 12/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8. Set 1 hit 12 reps which is the top of the range, but sets 2 and 3 dropped back to 10 and all three sets at RPE 8. Progress from last week (where all three were 10 reps) but not consistent enough yet. Upper back on the bench, drive through the heels, full hip extension at the top, hard squeeze for one full second. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 8 or under to earn 85.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Staying at 55 ? you went 12/15/12 at RPE 7/8/8. Set 2 actually hit the top of the range but sets 1 and 3 landed at the bottom, and sets 2 and 3 came in at RPE 8. The response to 55 is in the right range ? not too easy, not too hard ? but it's not consistent across all three sets yet. Curl the heels toward the glutes, full ROM, controlled on the way back down. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 or under to earn 60.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Captain's Chair Knee Raise this week. You went 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 on the knee raise ? solid baseline but RPE crept up across the session. Hanging leg raise is the next step up: hang from the pull-up bar on the rack, raise your knees to chest height, control the descent all the way down ? no swinging, no dropping. The free hang adds a grip and stability challenge the chair doesn't. First baseline session ? aim for 10-12 reps at RPE 7-8. Log all three sets.

days.cooldown: Stretch quads, hamstrings, hip flexors ? 5 min
